panels.title: Market direction (M)
panels.description:
The "M" of CAN SLIM, read from the market proxy (NIFTYBEES by default) at the last scan.

- **Confirmed uptrend** — above a rising 50-day average with few distribution days. Buy signals are actionable.
- **Uptrend under pressure** — 4-5 distribution days, or below the 50-day. Be selective.
- **Correction** — below a falling 50-day average, or 6+ distribution days. Buy setups are held back.

A **distribution day** is an index decline of 0.2% or more on higher volume than the day before: institutions selling.

panels.title: Buy signals, and setups about to rally
panels.description:
Stocks that passed the screener.in fundamentals query and whose chart lines up with O'Neil's buy rules.

- **Buy: breakout today / in buy range** — closed above the base's pivot on at least 1.4x average volume, and is no more than 5% above it.
- **Watch: near pivot** — within 5% under the pivot of a sound base. This is the *about to rally* list: the breakout is a close above the pivot on heavy volume.
- **Extended** — broke out but is now past the 5% buy range; chasing it raises the risk.
- **Setup, market in correction** — would be a buy or a watch, but M is negative.

**CAN SLIM** shows each letter that passed; '-' failed, '?' unknown. **RS** is the 1-99 relative-strength percentile against everything priced in the scan; CAN SLIM wants 80+.

Click a symbol to chart it below. These are rule readings, not advice.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT symbol                         AS "Symbol",
       signal                         AS "Signal",
       letters                        AS "CAN SLIM",
       rs_rating                      AS "RS",
       close                          AS "Close",
       pivot                          AS "Pivot",
       ROUND(pct_from_pivot, 1)       AS "vs pivot %",
       base_sessions                  AS "Base (sessions)",
       ROUND(base_depth_pct, 1)       AS "Base depth %",
       ROUND(volume_ratio, 2)         AS "Volume vs 50d",
       ROUND(qtr_profit_growth, 1)    AS "Qtr profit %",
       ROUND(profit_growth_3y, 1)     AS "3y profit %",
       ROUND(roe, 1)                  AS "ROE %",
       reason                         AS "Why"
FROM v_canslim_latest
WHERE signal IN ('BUY_BREAKOUT', 'BUY_ZONE', 'WATCH_SETUP', 'AVOID_MARKET', 'EXTENDED')
ORDER BY CASE signal WHEN 'BUY_BREAKOUT' THEN 0 WHEN 'BUY_ZONE' THEN 1 WHEN 'WATCH_SETUP' THEN 2
                     WHEN 'AVOID_MARKET' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
         letters_passed DESC, rs_rating DESC

panels.title: Rallies that have ended - sell signals
panels.description:
O'Neil's exits, checked for every stock with a rally to end: recent breakouts, open positions, and the configured universe.

- **Stop loss** — the close is 8% or more below the buy point (your average cost for a holding, otherwise the breakout's pivot).
- **Rally ended** — a close below the 50-day moving average on heavy volume (1.4x average or more).
- **Climax top** — 20%+ above the buy point and either up 25% in three weeks, or posting its biggest gain since the breakout on its heaviest volume: the run is exhausting itself.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT symbol                                   AS "Symbol",
       signal                                   AS "Signal",
       LOWER(source)                            AS "Why scanned",
       close                                    AS "Close",
       buy_point                                AS "Buy point",
       ROUND((close - buy_point) / buy_point * 100.0, 1) AS "vs buy point %",
       sma50                                    AS "50-day avg",
       rs_rating                                AS "RS",
       reason                                   AS "Why"
FROM v_canslim_latest
WHERE signal LIKE 'SELL_%'
ORDER BY CASE signal WHEN 'SELL_STOP_LOSS' THEN 0 WHEN 'SELL_TREND_BREAK' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, symbol

panels.title: $symbol - daily candles, 50/200-day averages and the pivot
panels.description:
Daily bars as priced by the last scan.

- **SMA 50 / SMA 200** — the 50- and 200-day moving averages. A heavy-volume close below the 50-day is the classic sign a rally is over.
- **Pivot** — the base's high a breakout has to clear (or the pivot of the latest breakout).
- **Buy / Sell signal** — the days a scan flagged one.
- **Volume** (bars) — shares traded each day; a breakout wants 1.4x the 50-day average.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT b.ts_epoch     AS time,
       b.open, b.high, b.low, b.close, b.volume,
       b.sma50        AS "SMA 50",
       b.sma200       AS "SMA 200",
       l.pivot        AS "Pivot",
       CASE WHEN h.signal IN ('BUY_BREAKOUT', 'BUY_ZONE') THEN b.close END AS "Buy signal",
       CASE WHEN h.signal LIKE 'SELL_%' THEN b.close END              AS "Sell signal"
FROM v_daily_bars b
LEFT JOIN v_canslim_latest l ON l.symbol = b.symbol
LEFT JOIN (SELECT symbol, as_of, MAX(signal) AS signal FROM v_canslim_signal_history
           WHERE signal IN ('BUY_BREAKOUT', 'BUY_ZONE') OR signal LIKE 'SELL_%'
           GROUP BY symbol, as_of) h
       ON h.symbol = b.symbol AND h.as_of = b.session_date
WHERE b.symbol = '$symbol'
ORDER BY b.session_date

panels.description: How the reading for this stock has changed scan by scan: when a setup appeared, when it broke out, when it was sold.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT datetime(run_at, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AS "Scanned",
       as_of        AS "As of",
       signal       AS "Signal",
       letters      AS "CAN SLIM",
       rs_rating    AS "RS",
       close        AS "Close",
       pivot        AS "Pivot",
       market_state AS "Market",
       reason       AS "Why"
FROM v_canslim_signal_history
WHERE symbol = '$symbol'
ORDER BY run_at DESC
LIMIT 60

panels.title: Every stock in the last scan
panels.description:
The full score sheet.

- **C** — latest quarter's profit up 25%+ year on year, with sales up 20%+.
- **A** — three-year profit growth 25%+ and ROE 17%+.
- **N** — within 15% of its 52-week high.
- **S** — more volume on up days than down days over 50 sessions.
- **L** — RS rating 80+.
- **I** — institutions (FII + DII) added to their holding last quarter.
- **M** — the market is in a confirmed uptrend.

C, A and I come from screener.in, so they are unknown ('?') for stocks that were scanned only because you hold them or they are in the configured universe.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT symbol                         AS "Symbol",
       LOWER(source)                  AS "Why scanned",
       signal                         AS "Signal",
       letters                        AS "CAN SLIM",
       letters_passed                 AS "Letters passed",
       rs_rating                      AS "RS",
       close                          AS "Close",
       ROUND(pct_from_high, 1)        AS "Below 52w high %",
       ROUND(up_down_volume, 2)       AS "Up/down volume",
       ROUND(qtr_profit_growth, 1)    AS "Qtr profit %",
       ROUND(qtr_sales_growth, 1)     AS "Qtr sales %",
       ROUND(profit_growth_3y, 1)     AS "3y profit %",
       ROUND(roe, 1)                  AS "ROE %",
       ROUND(institutional_change, 2) AS "FII+DII change",
       reason                         AS "Why"
FROM v_canslim_latest
ORDER BY letters_passed DESC, rs_rating DESC
